<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$category_definitions = array(
    array(
        'name'   => 'Educational Toys',
        'parent' => null,
    ),
    array(
        'name'   => 'Wooden Toys',
        'parent' => null,
    ),
    array(
        'name'   => 'Puzzles',
        'parent' => null,
    ),
    array(
        'name'   => 'Motor Skills',
        'parent' => null,
    ),
    array(
        'name'   => 'Construction Toys',
        'parent' => 'Educational Toys',
    ),
    array(
        'name'   => 'Wooden Puzzles',
        'parent' => 'Puzzles',
    ),
    array(
        'name'   => 'Balance & Coordination',
        'parent' => 'Motor Skills',
    ),
    array(
        'name'   => 'Sorting & Stacking',
        'parent' => 'Wooden Toys',
    ),
);

$tags = array(
    'Montessori',
    'Age 2+',
    'Age 3+',
    'Indoor',
    'Popular',
    'New'
);

$category_ids = array();
$tag_ids = array();

foreach ($category_definitions as $category_data) {
    $category_name = $category_data['name'];
    $parent_id = 0;

    if ($category_data['parent'] && isset($category_ids[$category_data['parent']])) {
        $parent_id = $category_ids[$category_data['parent']];
    }

    $term = term_exists($category_name, 'product_cat');

    if (!$term) {
        $term = wp_insert_term(
            $category_name,
            'product_cat',
            array(
                'parent' => $parent_id,
            )
        );
    }

    if (!is_wp_error($term)) {
        $term_id = is_array($term) ? (int) $term['term_id'] : (int) $term;
        $category_ids[$category_name] = $term_id;

        if ($parent_id) {
            wp_update_term(
                $term_id,
                'product_cat',
                array(
                    'parent' => $parent_id,
                )
            );
        }
    }
}

foreach ($tags as $tag_name) {
    $term = term_exists($tag_name, 'product_tag');

    if (!$term) {
        $term = wp_insert_term($tag_name, 'product_tag');
    }

    if (!is_wp_error($term)) {
        $tag_ids[$tag_name] = is_array($term) ? (int) $term['term_id'] : (int) $term;
    }
}

$products = array(
    array(
        'name'       => 'Wooden Shape Sorter',
        'price'      => '79.90',
        'categories' => array('Educational Toys', 'Wooden Toys'),
        'tags'       => array('Montessori', 'Age 2+')
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Animal Puzzle',
        'price'      => '59.90',
        'categories' => array('Puzzles'),
        'tags'       => array('Age 3+', 'Popular')
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Wooden Stacking Tower',
        'price'      => '69.90',
        'categories' => array('Sorting & Stacking'),
        'tags'       => array('Montessori', 'Indoor')
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Balance Blocks',
        'price'      => '89.90',
        'categories' => array('Balance & Coordination'),
        'tags'       => array('Age 3+', 'New')
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Simple Wooden Puzzle',
        'price'      => '49.90',
        'categories' => array('Wooden Puzzles'),
        'tags'       => array()
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Montessori Activity Board',
        'price'      => '119.90',
        'categories' => array('Educational Toys'),
        'tags'       => array('Montessori', 'Popular')
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Indoor Motor Skills Toy',
        'price'      => '99.90',
        'categories' => array(),
        'tags'       => array('Indoor', 'Age 2+')
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Untargeted Test Product',
        'price'      => '39.90',
        'categories' => array(),
        'tags'       => array()
    )
);

foreach ($products as $product_data) {
    $existing = get_page_by_title($product_data['name'], OBJECT, 'product');

    if ($existing) {
        continue;
    }

    $product = new WC_Product_Simple();
    $product->set_name($product_data['name']);
    $product->set_status('publish');
    $product->set_regular_price($product_data['price']);
    $product->set_catalog_visibility('visible');

    $product_id = $product->save();

    $product_category_ids = array();
    foreach ($product_data['categories'] as $category_name) {
        if (isset($category_ids[$category_name])) {
            $product_category_ids[] = $category_ids[$category_name];
        }
    }

    $product_tag_ids = array();
    foreach ($product_data['tags'] as $tag_name) {
        if (isset($tag_ids[$tag_name])) {
            $product_tag_ids[] = $tag_ids[$tag_name];
        }
    }

    if ($product_category_ids) {
        wp_set_object_terms($product_id, $product_category_ids, 'product_cat');
    }

    if ($product_tag_ids) {
        wp_set_object_terms($product_id, $product_tag_ids, 'product_tag');
    }
}

$variable_products = array(
    array(
        'name'       => 'Wooden Balance Board',
        'categories' => array('Balance & Coordination'),
        'tags'       => array('Montessori', 'Age 3+'),
        'attribute'  => 'Size',
        'variations' => array(
            'Small'  => '129.90',
            'Medium' => '159.90',
            'Large'  => '189.90',
        ),
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Montessori Peg Puzzle',
        'categories' => array('Wooden Puzzles'),
        'tags'       => array('Montessori', 'Age 2+'),
        'attribute'  => 'Theme',
        'variations' => array(
            'Farm'   => '64.90',
            'Ocean'  => '69.90',
            'Safari' => '74.90',
        ),
    ),
    array(
        'name'       => 'Wooden Building Set',
        'categories' => array('Construction Toys'),
        'tags'       => array('Indoor', 'Popular'),
        'attribute'  => 'Set Size',
        'variations' => array(
            '24 Pieces' => '89.90',
            '48 Pieces' => '139.90',
            '72 Pieces' => '189.90',
        ),
    ),
);

foreach ($variable_products as $product_data) {
    $existing = get_page_by_title($product_data['name'], OBJECT, 'product');

    if ($existing) {
        continue;
    }

    $product = new WC_Product_Variable();
    $product->set_name($product_data['name']);
    $product->set_status('publish');
    $product->set_catalog_visibility('visible');

    $attribute = new WC_Product_Attribute();
    $attribute->set_id(0);
    $attribute->set_name($product_data['attribute']);
    $attribute->set_options(array_keys($product_data['variations']));
    $attribute->set_position(0);
    $attribute->set_visible(true);
    $attribute->set_variation(true);

    $product->set_attributes(array($attribute));

    $product_category_ids = array();
    foreach ($product_data['categories'] as $category_name) {
        if (isset($category_ids[$category_name])) {
            $product_category_ids[] = $category_ids[$category_name];
        }
    }

    $product_tag_ids = array();
    foreach ($product_data['tags'] as $tag_name) {
        if (isset($tag_ids[$tag_name])) {
            $product_tag_ids[] = $tag_ids[$tag_name];
        }
    }

    $product->set_category_ids($product_category_ids);
    $product->set_tag_ids($product_tag_ids);

    $product_id = $product->save();

    foreach ($product_data['variations'] as $option => $price) {
        $variation = new WC_Product_Variation();
        $variation->set_parent_id($product_id);
        $variation->set_status('publish');
        $variation->set_regular_price($price);
        $variation->set_attributes(
            array(
                sanitize_title($product_data['attribute']) => $option,
            )
        );
        $variation->save();
    }

    WC_Product_Variable::sync($product_id);
    wc_delete_product_transients($product_id);
}
